source: DFL and Bassek et al. (2025), CC BY 4.0, https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.28196177
role: first successful evaluation after frozen exit-only selection; now consumed for diagnostics, not a holdout for any candidate derived from these findings
parser_adaptation: Use the complete BALL FrameSet, not an optional or position-dependent referee FrameSet, to establish each 25-fps half timeline; regression tests cover referee-first, player-first and referee-absent ordering. Previously frozen J03WMX output hashes reproduce exactly.

fresh_match_official_flags.interpretation: The exit cue slightly raises ranked-like provider spell-F1 but does not recover dead frames here, adds 35 false-dead known-live frames, and lowers the high-IoU score; this is not a challenge score.

vendor_encoding_warning.decision: Reject the stationary-border dead cue before implementation: DFL freezes ball positions as a provider convention, whereas independently known-live Metrica frames dominate its activation.

live_owner_geometry_diagnostic.interpretation: Proximity is weakest during long or fast ball flight, but prior owner-flight policies already failed external high-IoU and masked-recovery guards. Do not equate provider possession flags with independently verified touches.

next_gate: Keep J03WOY, J03WPY, J03WQQ and J03WR9 uninspected. Develop any future cue on other development sources, predeclare a guard and freeze it before touching an untouched DFL match; never select by the hackathon public possession window.
